description: Views for the Phase 0 parity and performance gates (DESIGN section 5.4): both three.js runners in --parity on each (scene, view, mode). Covers a point light on a plane, shadows at a thin wall, a doorway, an off-screen sunlit patch and the realworld courtyard (sun + sky), each in direct and probe mode (offscreen_source in probe only: its direct view is black by design).
